page.content:
Demon named in the film's Iraq and possession thread.

How Pazuzu connects

  • Character: Regan MacNeil — Regan's body is the site of Pazuzu's possession.
  • Character: Father Damien Karras — Karras takes the demon on in the final challenge.
  • Character: Father Lankester Merrin — Merrin has faced this demon before Nineveh and Georgetown.
  • Work: The Exorcist (1973) — The 1973 film frames the demon through Pazuzu's image.
  • Concept: Captain Howdy — Captain Howdy is the name that precedes Pazuzu's reveal.
  • Location: Nineveh — The Pazuzu image is unearthed at Nineveh.

What is Pazuzu?

Pazuzu is the ancient wind-demon the prologue and later lore attach to Regan's possession — the intelligence behind Captain Howdy.

Key threads lead to Regan MacNeil, Father Damien Karras, Father Lankester Merrin, The Exorcist (1973), Captain Howdy and Nineveh.
